workflow: A code generator assigns a generic calling convention and dispatch flags to a class-associated callable.
The generated callable implementation uses a different parameter layout and a more specific first-argument type than that convention permits.
Dispatch invokes the implementation through an incompatible function-pointer cast, supplying arguments according to the generic convention.
Undefined-behavior instrumentation detects the mismatched indirect call and aborts instead of completing the invocation.
summary: Incompatible generated callback signature invoked through generic dispatch
